description: Makes a deck of up to 500 cards and returns a link. When the person opens the link, Ordkort shows the deck and adds it to their cards if they agree. Pictures are given by an https address (for example from find_pictures), and so is the deck's cover (cover_url), a small picture shown instead of the emoji. The link works for a year.

image_credit.description: Whom to credit, with the licence

image_url.description: An https address of a picture

term.description: The word in the target language, with its article for a noun ("et hus", "der Hund")

cover_credit.description: Whom to credit for the cover, with the licence

cover_url.description: Optional: an https address of a small picture for the deck, shown instead of the emoji (a square crop of it, 64 px). For example the first result of find_pictures for the topic.

native.description: A language code from list_languages, such as "nb", "en", "uk"

target.description: A language code from list_languages, such as "nb", "en", "uk"

name: create_deck
title: Make a deck
